feed.title: Awesome DSH Plugin — Curated DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Plugin List

entry.title: dsh-crosstalk
entry.summary: Cross-session messaging for DSH: any session on the machine can list and message any other, Claude Code-style, via a local heartbeat registry and inbox.

entry.title: nowledge-mem-deepseek-harness
entry.summary: One memory layer for every AI tool and agent: Context Bundle injection, prompt-time recall, MCP tools, and turn-end DSH thread capture.

entry.title: dsh-memory
entry.summary: Cited memory over DSH's lossless session log: distilled facts carry `(sessionId, eventRange)` citations that expand back to the exact original log excerpt.

entry.title: dsh-cowork
entry.summary: Bounded, cell-addressed `doc_read`/`doc_write` for xlsx / pdf / docx / pptx / ipynb, plus an MCP server and CLI.

entry.title: dsh-skillport
entry.summary: Bring your existing Agent Skills (SKILL.md) library to DSH: discover skills across Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini paths, inject a progressive-disclosure index, and load bodies on demand.

entry.title: dsh-apple-mode
entry.summary: Xcode AI integration for DSH: 26 Xcode MCP tools (mcpbridge) + Apple platform skills + Xcode Intelligence-style persona (agent preset or global bundle).

entry.title: dsh-routines
entry.summary: Scheduled agents on a cron: run a prompt on a schedule and get the digest where you already are, with overlap/missed-run/timeout safety defaults.

entry.title: dsh-chatnode-wechat
entry.summary: Chat with, monitor, and approve your DSH agents from WeChat via the iLink gateway: text both ways, session targeting, digest heartbeats, and numbered approval prompts.

entry.title: dsh-polyglot
entry.summary: The model switch for DSH: point it at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with curated free/cheap DeepSeek provider presets and automatic fallback when a free tier rate-limits you.

entry.title: dsh-tianshu-tui
entry.summary: A terminal UI (TUI) for DeepSeek Harness.

entry.title: dsh-at-file
entry.summary: Codex-style `@file` mentions: search workspace files in the composer and attach their contents to prompts.

entry.title: ui-status-label
entry.summary: Customize the "deep diving" thinking status label to anything you like.

entry.title: dsh-openpencil
entry.summary: OpenPencil design preview and editing plugin.

entry.title: dsh-visualize
entry.summary: In-conversation generative UI: the model renders interactive HTML cards into the chat stream, with streaming preview and sandboxed rendering.

entry.title: dsh-side-panel
entry.summary: Side panel with file browser, terminal, and Git review for quick file previews.

entry.title: dsh-focus-chat
entry.summary: A "focus chat" minimal view that shows only final outputs.

entry.title: dsh-genui
entry.summary: Interactive UI components rendered inline in replies: layout, charts, forms, quizzes, mermaid, 3D scenes, and an action event loop back to the model.

entry.title: dsh-annotation
entry.summary: Select text → annotate → send with your message; replies map back to each annotation.

entry.title: dsh-navbar
entry.summary: Conversation node navigation bar for quick jumps between user messages.

entry.title: dsh-task-status
entry.summary: Background task status bar: progress plus live output tail on the chat page.

entry.title: dsh-web-archive
entry.summary: Collapse noisy messages (Think, Bash, etc.) in conversations.

entry.title: dsh-spotlight
entry.summary: Keyboard-first command palette for the DSH Web UI.

entry.title: dsh-101
entry.summary: Document reading mode for DSH.

entry.title: dsh-drag-and-drop
entry.summary: Cross-platform file drag-and-drop with raw path insertion, no file copying.

entry.title: dsh-deeplink
entry.summary: Deep links: open a specific session or workspace via `?session=` / `?workspace=`.

entry.title: dsh-diff-viewer
entry.summary: PiUI-style diff viewer replacing the stock DiffBlock for write/edit tool calls.

entry.title: ex-setting
entry.summary: Settings extensions for DSH.

entry.title: web-components
entry.summary: Web Components support.

entry.title: dsh-turn-navigator
entry.summary: Turn navigation for the DSH Web UI.

entry.title: dsh-milestone
entry.summary: Right-side dot-timeline rail: jump between user messages.
